title: Edgar Mitchell speaks out on UFOs

plain: Edgar Mitchell, an astronaut who flew on Apollo 14 in 1971, is said to have gone on to speak publicly about UFOs in the decades that followed. Michels gives him as an example himself, without naming a source, in an episode where he debates a skeptic. He does not say what Mitchell said, only that a man who had been to the Moon was willing to speak out.
